mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_cluster_link WHERE cluster_id IN #{id} AND relation_role = 'MAIN' AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY feedback_source_id, id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM t_cluster_link WHERE feedback_source_id IN #{id} AND relation_role = 'CANDIDATE' AND is_active = 1 AND review_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY feedback_source_id, candidate_rank, id
SELECT DISTINCT cluster_id FROM t_cluster_link WHERE feedback_source_id = #{sourceId} AND review_status = 'REJECTED' ORDER BY cluster_id
SELECT FROM t_cluster_link WHERE review_request_id=#{reviewRequestId} ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO t_cluster_link(cluster_id, feedback_source_id, relation_role, link_type, match_similarity, candidate_rank, match_evidence, decision_version, decision_config_version, feature_snapshot, problem_fingerprint, review_status, review_version, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, review_reason, review_request_id, decision_reason, reclassification_run_id, is_active) VALUES
(#{row.clusterId}, #{row.feedbackSourceId}, #{row.relationRole}, #{row.linkType}, #{row.matchSimilarity}, #{row.candidateRank}, CAST(#{row.matchEvidence} AS JSON), #{row.decisionVersion}, #{row.decisionConfigVersion}, CAST(#{row.featureSnapshot} AS JSON), #{row.problemFingerprint}, #{row.reviewStatus}, #{row.reviewVersion}, #{row.reviewedBy}, CASE WHEN #{row.reviewedBy} IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE NOW(3) END, #{row.reviewReason}, #{row.reviewRequestId}, #{row.decisionReason}, #{row.reclassificationRunId}, 1)
mapper.update:
UPDATE t_cluster_link SET is_active = CASE WHEN feedback_source_id = #{row.sourceId} THEN IF(#{row.deactivate},0,is_active) ELSE is_active END, review_status = CASE
WHEN feedback_source_id = #{row.sourceId} THEN CASE WHEN #{row.deactivate} THEN CASE WHEN #{row.selectedClusterId} IS NOT NULL AND cluster_id <> #{row.selectedClusterId} THEN 'REJECTED' ELSE #{row.status} END ELSE review_status END
ELSE review_status END, reviewed_by = CASE WHEN feedback_source_id = #{row.sourceId} AND #{row.deactivate} THEN #{row.reviewerId} ELSE reviewed_by END, reviewed_at = CASE WHEN feedback_source_id = #{row.sourceId} AND #{row.deactivate} THEN NOW(3) ELSE reviewed_at END, review_reason = CASE
WHEN feedback_source_id = #{row.sourceId} AND (#{row.deactivate} OR candidate_rank = 1) THEN #{row.reason}
ELSE review_reason END, review_request_id = CASE
WHEN feedback_source_id = #{row.sourceId} AND ((#{row.selectedClusterId} IS NOT NULL AND cluster_id = #{row.selectedClusterId}) OR (#{row.selectedClusterId} IS NULL AND candidate_rank = 1)) THEN #{row.requestId}
ELSE review_request_id END, review_version = review_version + 1 WHERE relation_role = 'CANDIDATE' AND is_active = 1 AND review_status = 'PENDING' AND (
(feedback_source_id = #{row.sourceId} AND review_version = #{row.expectedVersion}) )

UPDATE t_cluster_link SET is_active = 0, review_status = 'SKIPPED', reviewed_at = NOW(3), review_reason = #{reason}, review_version = review_version + 1, decision_reason = CONCAT_WS('；', NULLIF(decision_reason,''), #{reason}) WHERE relation_role = 'CANDIDATE' AND is_active = 1 AND review_status = 'PENDING' AND (
(id = #{row.linkId} AND review_version = #{row.expectedVersion}) )

UPDATE t_cluster_link SET match_evidence = JSON_SET(COALESCE(match_evidence,JSON_OBJECT()), '$.name_evolution', JSON_OBJECT('from',#{from},'to',#{to},'rule_version','cluster-name-v1', 'source_id',#{sourceId},'updated_at',NOW(3))) WHERE feedback_source_id = #{sourceId} AND cluster_id = #{clusterId} AND relation_role = 'MAIN' AND is_active = 1
